name: dsd-fme
label: Digital voice: P25 / NXDN / D-STAR / YSF (dsd-fme)
description: Multi-protocol digital voice through the operator-installed dsd-fme helper (native only): DMR, P25 Phase 1/2, NXDN, D-STAR, YSF, dPMR — call metadata and decoded speech.
ai_notes: Multi-protocol digital voice via DsdHelper, which runs the operator-installed `dsd-fme` (not shipped; `FERRITE_DSD_FME` / `helper_path`) on 48 kHz discriminator audio: DMR, P25 Phase 1/2, NXDN48/96, D-STAR, YSF, dPMR auto-detected (`mode`), call records (protocol, slot, TG, source, CC, ENC) and talker aliases in `ui:dsd`, speech on the audio chain. Native only. For DMR prefer the `dmr` preset (Ferrite's own decoder + vocoder, also runs in the browser). Bay Area: P25 system WACN BEE00 / SYS 5E4 control channels 774.20625 (site 2), 773.45625 (site 5), 772.30625 (site 1) MHz, Phase II voice 770.28125 / 770.55625 MHz (Antenna B, gain 50); conventional DMR 441.850 MHz. Output: `tail decoder --category dsd`; `await dsd`.
